source: skeptic-final classifications for group g2 as handed to the judge (wf 568 measurement); the skeptic's fetch cache is scratchpad g2skep/data. Group totals: 12 tenders, 68 blocks: unique_right 59, no_match 6, no_number 3.

tenders.cn_lot_number_field: TED-LOT_NUMBER prints the letters A, B, C; TED-ITEM is 1, 2, 3
tenders.lot_keys_vs_printed: LOT-k is the ordinal (= CN ITEM), NOT the printed number: LOT-1 prints 'A', LOT-2 'B', LOT-3 'C'
tenders.notes: The CAN numbers lots differently from its CN: LOT_NUMBER 1/2/3 plus TED-ITEM 1/2/3 (the only CAN ITEM ordinals in g2). A printed-number match finds nothing. A CN-ITEM / LOT-k ordinal fallback would be right for all 3 (each CAN INITIAL_ESTIMATED equals the VALUE_COST of the CN lot with the same ITEM: 1,000,000 / 1,600,000 / 300,000 CZK). LOT-1 and LOT-2 titles differ only by ', Alpha screen'.

blocks.why: No lot section of CN 16925302 prints '1' (A/B/C). RES-1 'Microplate reader - absorbance, fluorescence, luminiscence, Alpha screen.' is LOT-1 (printed 'A', ITEM 1); estimate 1,000,000 CZK = CN LOT-1 VALUE_COST; winner PE Systems s. r. o.
No CN section prints '2'. RES-2 'Microplate reader - absorbance, fluorescence, luminiscence.' is LOT-2 (printed 'B', ITEM 2); estimate 1,600,000 CZK = CN LOT-2 value; winner SCHOELLER INSTRUMENTS.
No CN section prints '3'. RES-3 'Spektrofotometr - absorbance.' is LOT-3 (printed 'C', ITEM 3); estimate 300,000 CZK = CN LOT-3 value; winner SCHOELLER INSTRUMENTS.
